brief:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani posted a video showing himself planting an olive tree alongside Palestinian families from Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The footage documented the act as a gesture of solidarity with those affected by the conflict.

Details about the families' identities, the location of the planting, or the broader context of Mamdani's visit remain unclear from available reporting.
dek: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani posted a video of himself planting an olive tree alongside Palestinian families from Gaza.
title: NYC official plants olive tree with Gaza families
